modality_provenance.quote: Chest radiograph demonstrating airspace shadowing in the left lower lung zone associated with a small left-sided pleural effusion.
Repeat chest radiograph 6 weeks following antibiotic treatment demonstrating partial resolution of the radiographic findings with a small residual opacity in the left retrocardiac region.
A repeat chest radiograph a year later due to recurrent symptoms demonstrates increased opacification in the retrocardiac region.
